report:
Left ovary and fallopian tube, salpingo-oophorectomy

The specimen consists of a left salpingo-oophorectomy specimen received intact (160 g, 75 x 60 x 50 mm). The left ovary is replaced by a mass measuring 70 mm in greatest dimension (70 x 55 x 50 mm). The outer surface bears papillary excrescences. Cut surface shows chocolate-brown fluid and solid areas. The fallopian tube is unremarkable.

(1-6) Ovarian tumour, including surface.
(7) Fallopian tube, entirely embedded (SEE-FIM).

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Left salpingo-oophorectomy
- Specimen integrity (left ovary): Capsule intact
- Specimen integrity (left fallopian tube): Serosa intact
- Tumour site: Left ovary
- Ovarian surface involvement: Present, left
- Fallopian tube surface involvement: Not identified
- Tumour size: 70 mm in greatest dimension (70 x 55 x 50 mm)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Endometrioid carcinoma
- Histologic grade: FIGO grade 2 (endometrioid carcinoma)
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show an endometrioid carcinoma. Solid non-squamous growth is 6-50% with mild to moderate nuclear atypia. The carcinoma arises in the wall of an endometriotic cyst with adjacent atypical endometriosis. Immunohistochemistry: p53 shows a wild-type pattern; ER positive, PR positive, WT1 negative, Napsin A negative; MMR proteins retained.
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- p53 immunohistochemistry: Normal (wild type)
- Largest extrapelvic peritoneal focus: Not applicable
- Peritoneal / ascitic fluid: Malignant cells not identified
- Other tissue / organ involvement: Not identified

Additional findings
- Endometriosis

OVARY AND FALLOPIAN TUBE, left, salpingo-oophorectomy
- ENDOMETRIOID CARCINOMA, FIGO grade 2, 70 mm, ovarian surface involved; see
  synoptic report
